name: TreeRingTimeline
job: Present the years a business has been going as tree rings that grow outward from the centre, each ring labelled with that year's milestone
visitor_action: hover or tap a ring to read its milestone; arrow keys step through years
mobile: smaller disc, milestone list underneath instead of hover labels
motion: rings draw outward one by one with eased stroke, hovered ring thickens with spring (reduced-motion: all rings drawn, static)

checks.render: pass (1 fix: single-column grid track at narrow widths + no list auto-scroll on load)

art_direction: Botanical section: near-white ground, honey and walnut rings with tiny growth-line irregularities as the only material, deep forest-green humanist sans labels, flat hairline list
